summary: Join our Oil and Gas Accounting and Taxation Training Course to develop critical skills and knowledge for effective financial management in the energy sector.
lede: Oil and gas accounting links exploration and development costs, production and lifting data, revenue, liabilities, and tax to project accounts. Designed for petroleum accountants, joint venture accountants, tax managers, and finance controllers, the training develops practical skills in reviewing AFE costs, reconciling production, lifting, and sales, preparing petroleum tax workpapers, and assessing deferred tax and impairment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, govern, or use petroleum project financial and tax information. It suits intermediate to advanced learners with operating exposure who need stronger control over accounting judgments, partner reporting, and tax evidence.
outcomes: Successful Efforts Vs Full Cost Accounting
prerequisites: Working knowledge of financial accounting and basic tax concepts is required. Experience with oil and gas operations, joint ventures, project finance, production data, or ERP-based reporting will help you apply the exercises more quickly. No programming is required. Advanced topics such as Power BI dashboard design, IAS 12 analysis, and petroleum fiscal modelling receive operational application rather than technical engineering treatment. Bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel; no software pre-installation is required unless you choose to use an existing Power BI environment.
